title: Keep captured QA when a successor takes over
when: After an ended predecessor leaves a QA execution on the claimed item.
need: Acquire the item work claim, explicitly adopt the same execution, then review its captured evidence or resume its original exact-ID command. Live or parked predecessors and missing session evidence refuse adoption. Transfer records are durable; adoption preserves captures, bundle identity and terminal state without reviving released host custody.
surface: Restaff recipe, QA ownership refusal and adopt help
review: Candidate regression coverage; deployed proof pending.
